'''Amadaine 9 (June 16)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Ingtar Shinowa|Ingtar's]] party reach the [[River Erinin|Erinin]]. Once the cross, they find deserted villages and a [[Myrddraal]] nailed to the door. [[Rand]] has a strange repeated experience in one village, which he breaks by channeling. At camp that night, Rand discovers [[Moiraine]] has given him the [[Dragon Banner]].
*{{ne|998}} - The [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin's]] party reaches [[Medo]] and takes a ship downriver.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]] and the [[Aiel]] leave [[Rhuidean]] for [[Cold Rocks Hold]]. They meet a party of [[:Category:Peddlers|peddlers]] led by [[Hadnan Kadere]]. Camping at [[Imre Stand]], they are attacked that night by [[Trolloc]]s.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Eldrith Jhondar]], one of the [[Black Ajah]] in [[Tanchico]], learns that the [[Domination Band|device]] to control Rand is in the [[Panarch's Palace]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Perrin]] and his men find a burned farmhouse and track down and destroy a party of thirty-two Trollocs.
